signUp.title: Create your LivTales account
signUp.passwordHint: Passwords must be at least 10 characters long.
signUp.usernameHint: Usernames may contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, must begin with a letter, and must be 3 to 30 characters long. Your username identifies you to other members and cannot be changed later.
signUp.fine: A verification code will be sent to this email address to confirm it before your first sign-in.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.intro: Enter the six-digit code sent to {email}. The code expires after fifteen minutes.
verify.introNoEmail: Enter the email address of the account and the six-digit code sent to it. The code expires after fifteen minutes.
verify.resent: A new code has been sent if this address has an unverified account.

welcome.title: Welcome to LivTales
welcome.intro: Choose a display name, and how dates and times are shown.
welcome.name: Display name
welcome.namePlaceholder: A nickname or your first name
welcome.nameHint: Friends and people you share with see this name. It doesn't have to be your real name.
welcome.hint: The time zone and clock format were detected from this device. These preferences can be changed at any time in Settings.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.introCode: Enter the six-digit code sent to {email} and choose a new password. Every other session of the account will be signed out.
reset.introEmail: Enter the email address of your account. A code to reset the password will be sent to it.

development.title: Open your space
development.intro: Try your planning space with a test name and email. Use the same email to return to your plans.
development.privacy: For trusted testing only. Email ownership is not verified, so anyone with an email can access that development identity. Do not use real personal data.
